item.title: Pentagon prepares for weeks of ground operations in Iran
item.summary: If President Trump approves the plans, such an effort would mark a new phase of the war that could be significantly more dangerous to U.S. troops than the first four weeks.

item.title: Trump ratchets up attacks on NATO, says U.S. no longer needs alliance
item.summary: President Donald Trump suggested the U.S. might move away from its commitment to defend NATO allies, criticizing them for not supporting the war in Iran.

item.title: At least 10 U.S. troops wounded in Iranian attack on Saudi air base
item.summary: The strike on Prince Sultan Air Base also damaged at least two Air Force refueling aircraft and underscored that despite weeks of strikes, Iran still poses a threat.

item.title: As Trump feels pressure to end war, allies fear what Iran may do next
item.summary: The oil price rose to $110 per barrel on Friday, as Iran has demonstrated it can inflict significant damage on the world’s economy, even while outgunned. That creates a dilemma for President Trump.

item.title: As Trump skips CPAC, MAGA’s rifts over Iran war are on display
item.summary: At the annual gathering of conservative activists, many express reservations about the war, amid support for Trump.

item.title: U.S. uses hundreds of Tomahawk missiles on Iran, alarming some at Pentagon
item.summary: More than 850 Tomahawks have been fired in just four weeks, people familiar with the matter said, alarming some Pentagon officials because the weapon’s supply is limited.

item.title: House GOP passes its own funding bill, rejecting Senate version, as shutdown drags on
item.summary: Senate Democrats have said the plan is “dead on arrival” in the upper chamber.

item.title: MAGA’s eruption has so far kept Trump from endorsing in key Senate race
item.summary: President Donald Trump seemed set to endorse Sen. John Cornyn in the Texas Republican primary runoff. But strong opposition from MAGA activists forestalled that.

item.title: Tracking who Trump is appointing to fill key administration roles
item.summary: Follow President Trump’s progress filling over 800 positions, among about 1,300 that require Senate confirmation, in this tracker from The Washington Post and the Partnership for Public Service.

item.title: Senate passes bill to reopen much of DHS after Trump moves to pay TSA officers
item.summary: The House still needs to pass the legislation before President Donald Trump can sign it into law.
